stories.title: The Moving Slippers
stories.summary: Kavero follows a trail of slippers and discovers that Fozzy has been furnishing his favourite spot beside Granny.

stories.title: The Humming Cupboard
stories.summary: A cupboard hums every afternoon, leading Kavero and Poppy to Dad’s electric toothbrush vibrating against a tin.

stories.title: The Vanishing Puddle
stories.summary: Kavero guards a shrinking puddle from an imaginary water thief while Granny wonders whether her washing has the same visitor.

stories.title: The Extra Footprints
stories.summary: Strange fork-shaped marks cross the garden path, and Pip’s enormous bird theory collapses when Granny brings out her walking stick.

stories.title: The Midnight Birthday
stories.summary: A birthday tune interrupts the family’s evening until Kavero traces it to a musical greeting card trapped beneath Granny’s cushion.

stories.title: The Upside-Down Visitor
stories.summary: Millie spots another child in her spoon, and Kavero investigates why this particular visitor insists on standing on his head.

stories.title: The Missing Applause
stories.summary: A recording of the children’s show contains a mysterious rustling instead of clapping—because the phone spent the performance in Granny’s pocket.

stories.title: The Pink Shirt Puzzle
stories.summary: Dad’s white shirt emerges pink, and Kavero discovers that a tiny red sock has had a much bigger laundry adventure than expected.

stories.title: The Silent Bell
stories.summary: A bicycle bell rings beautifully until someone holds the handlebars, making Toby’s helpful thumb the most surprising clue.

stories.title: The Travelling Rainbow
stories.summary: A patch of rainbow keeps changing seats around the kitchen, and Poppy helps Kavero trace it to sunlight passing through Granny’s glass.

stories.title: The Empty Bird Feeder
stories.summary: Kavero’s bird-watching notebook stays empty while the feeder empties too—until the children investigate the loose tray underneath it.

stories.title: The Squeaking Detective
stories.summary: Kavero searches every corner for an irritating squeak before discovering that the noise has been following him inside his own shoe.

stories.title: The Wrong-Way Arrow
stories.summary: A sign points visitors away from the school fair, and Kavero discovers that its cheerful directions turn whenever the wind does.

stories.title: The Disappearing Message
stories.summary: Poppy’s message vanishes from the bathroom mirror, but Kavero finds a way to invite it back without writing another word.

stories.title: The Mysterious Extra Guest
stories.summary: Every group photograph contains an unexpected pair of ears, although Miette apparently refuses to join the picture.

stories.title: The Hollow Snowman
stories.summary: The children’s snowman loses his middle before his head, and Kavero discovers the upturned bucket they forgot to remove.

stories.title: The Case of Tuesday
stories.summary: Granny and Dad insist it is different days, sending Kavero after a calendar page that has stuck where nobody thought to look.

stories.title: The Missing Detective
stories.summary: Kavero prepares a grand mystery-solving afternoon, then becomes so absorbed in writing clues that his friends have to follow them to find him.

stories.title: The No-Words Afternoon
stories.summary: Kavero communicates only through drawings, turning a simple request for a drink into Granny bringing him a watering can.

stories.title: The Ordinary Things Museum
stories.summary: Kavero displays the household’s most fascinating objects, then discovers that his visitors urgently need to use the exhibits.

stories.title: The Everything Picnic
stories.summary: Determined to forget nothing, Kavero packs so much for a picnic that there is nowhere left for anyone to sit.

stories.title: The Yes Day
stories.summary: Kavero agrees to every harmless suggestion until three promises collide and saying one small “not yet” becomes his best idea.

stories.title: The Inside-Out Outfit
stories.summary: Kavero wears his clothes inside out to keep the outside clean, then discovers that his beloved diary pocket has become rather difficult to reach.

stories.title: The Queue for Nothing
stories.summary: Kavero starts a queue before deciding what it is for, and everyone who joins brings a completely different expectation.

stories.title: The Tiny Holiday
stories.summary: Kavero declares a holiday in the hallway, with Granny as his travelling companion and the kitchen becoming a surprisingly distant destination.

stories.title: The Very Important Nothing
stories.summary: Kavero schedules an afternoon of doing absolutely nothing, then exhausts everyone explaining which activities count as something.

stories.title: The Borrowed Birthday
stories.summary: Kavero gives an ordinary Thursday a birthday party, but choosing what a day would like as a present proves unexpectedly difficult.

stories.title: The Wrong-Hand Club
stories.summary: The friends try familiar tasks with their other hands, producing wobbly drawings and a club register nobody can read.

stories.title: The Smallest Sports Day
stories.summary: Kavero shrinks every sporting event to fit the sitting room, where Granny becomes a surprisingly formidable cotton-ball champion.

stories.title: The Compliment Shop
stories.summary: Kavero opens a shop selling kind words, then discovers that the best compliments cannot be handed out from a ready-made list.

stories.title: The Instructions Holiday
stories.summary: Kavero decides to read the instructions only after playing a new game, leaving everyone convinced they have won by different rules.

stories.title: The Unbirthday Present
stories.summary: Kavero wraps a present before choosing what goes inside, and the increasingly elaborate wrapping becomes Millie’s favourite part.

stories.title: The Floor Has Names
stories.summary: Kavero renames parts of the house as countries, making a short trip to fetch Granny’s glasses require an astonishing number of directions.

stories.title: The Fastest Slow Walk
stories.summary: Kavero challenges his friends to arrive last on a short garden walk, and their attempts to lose reveal everything they usually rush past.

stories.title: The One-Word Restaurant
stories.summary: Kavero’s pretend restaurant allows customers only one word per order, which works beautifully until Granny says “usual.”

stories.title: The Perfect Ordinary Day
stories.summary: Kavero tries to have a day with no unusual ideas, but his friends keep asking what he would do—and ordinary becomes an adventure anyway.
